arguments.sql:
SELECT s.FundingType AS directory_funding_type,
       f."Charter Funding Type" AS frpm_funding_type,
       COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS directory_rows,
       COUNT(f.CDSCode) AS frpm_rows,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN s.CDSCode IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS frpm_rows_without_directory,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN s.CDSCode IS NOT NULL AND s.School IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS directory_rows_without_name,
       COUNT(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS enrollment_differences,
       AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS average_difference
FROM frpm AS f
LEFT JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.FundingType, f."Charter Funding Type"
UNION ALL
SELECT s.FundingType, NULL, COUNT(*), 0, 0,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN s.School IS NULL THEN 1 END), 0, NULL
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.CDSCode IS NULL
GROUP BY s.FundingType;
